name: Shoko MPC-HC
overview: Play episodes in MPC-HC directly from the Shoko Web UI. Includes one-time Windows link-handler setup.

releases.release_notes: Cast episodes to a Miracast TV through a separate cast agent on your network. Adds a TV button and TV casting settings. No Windows Setup update needed. Targets Shoko 6 dev.550 / Abstractions alpha.112.
